Jira-klienten i ditt skal: The Jira client in your shell
GodJIRA är ett program du kör själv. Det: GodJIRA is a program you run yourself. It shows your Jira account — the board with drag and drop, the backlog, the timeline, the reports, the issue list and the code map — with GitHub and the n8n flow beside them, and it speaks nine languages. Nothing sits in a cloud of mine: the app runs on your computer, with your token and your Jira instance.
